topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: So they found this time capsule, huh? They say they don’t remember burying it. Right. Like a man forgets where he hid the last piece of the puzzle. I’ve seen it before, the eyes wander, the hands fidget. They’re either protecting a secret or covering a mistake. Maybe both. Doesn’t matter much. The capsule’s open, and inside? Old photos, letters, a couple of trinkets. Dusty, just like the stories. They want to know what it all means. Little do they know, every memory’s got a price, and sooner or later, someone’s gonna have to pay.
